title: build_client adds cert as CA root not leaf pin
description: client.rs build_client uses reqwest::Certificate::from_der + add_root_certificate to pin the kithd cert. This adds the cert as a trusted CA root, not a pinned leaf. If kithd's self-signed cert is used directly (it is its own CA), this works. However the code comment says 'cert chain does not include it' which is imprecise: reqwest verifies that the cert chain terminates at a trusted root, meaning any cert signed by the pinned cert would also be trusted. For self-signed certs this is equivalent to leaf pinning. Risk: if cert handling changes in the future, the mental model matters. The comment should accurately describe what add_root_certificate does.
